controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Define request and response. API contract gate: every endpoint or form must have request fields, response fields, errors, and status codes before code.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Contract test sends valid, invalid, missing, and extra fields.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: API spec or form contract, test results, sample request and response payloads.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose HTTP method correctly. Method gate: reads use GET, creates use POST, replacements use PUT, partial changes use PATCH, removals use DELETE.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Method misuse test tries state change through GET and expects rejection.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Route table showing methods, controller tests, access logs showing correct method use.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use HTTPS. Transport gate: production must force encrypted traffic for all pages, APIs, forms, admin, and assets.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: HTTP request test confirms redirect to HTTPS and no mixed content.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: TLS certificate screenshot, redirect rule, security header report.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Validate request data. Validation gate: all route, query, body, file, and form inputs must be checked against rules.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Invalid type, length, range, missing field, and malformed payload tests.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Validation schema, failed validation screenshots, automated test output.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Return correct status codes. Response gate: success, client error, auth error, permission error, not found, conflict, and server error codes must be deliberate.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Force each failure path and verify status code plus message.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Status code matrix, API tests, error response samples.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Define API contract. Contract stability gate: endpoint names, payloads, errors, permissions, and versions must be documented.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Consumer style test proves clients can rely on the contract.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: OpenAPI or route contract, changelog, contract tests.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Preserve backwards compatibility. Compatibility gate: optional additions must not break old clients or old frontend code.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Run old client calls against the new version.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Backward compatibility test result, migration note, release note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Version breaking API changes. Versioning gate: breaking changes must create a new version or migration path.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Old v1 request still works while v2 handles the new contract.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Versioned route list, deprecation note, dual-version test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use pagination. Large data gate: no list endpoint, table, report, or admin screen may return unlimited records.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Seed large data and confirm limited pages.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Pagination test, page size rule, query log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Prefer cursor pagination for large changing data. Stable pagination gate: fast-changing lists must avoid page shifting where correctness matters.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Insert records during pagination and confirm no duplicates or missing records.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Cursor token design, test dataset result, endpoint sample.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Keep GET idempotent. Safe read gate: GET must not create, update, delete, send email, charge money, or change state.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Call GET repeatedly and compare database state before and after.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Idempotency test, route review, database diff result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add idempotency for risky writes. Duplicate safety gate: payment, webhook, import, form, email, and job retries must detect duplicates.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when coding any endpoint, form, route, action, webhook, API, admin action, or frontend request flow. If the work has no request flow, record not applicable with reason.
controls.required_test: Submit the same request twice and confirm only one business effect.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Idempotency key rule, unique constraint, duplicate request test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose REST, GraphQL, or gRPC based on need. API style gate: API style must be justified by simplicity, data precision, or service performance.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when choosing or changing an API style. Otherwise record the existing interface style and why no change is needed.
controls.required_test: Review one feature against overfetching, underfetching, auth, and latency needs.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Architecture decision record, interface sketch, performance assumption.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Keep services stateless where horizontal scaling is expected. Statelessness gate: any server instance must handle the request without local-only state.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for cloud, serverless, container, multi server, or any system expected to scale horizontally. Conditional for one server prototypes, but the reason must be recorded.
controls.required_test: Run the same request against two app instances.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Session storage design, load balancer test, state audit.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Design for load balancing. Load balancer gate: the feature must work behind a reverse proxy and across multiple backend instances.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the app is behind a reverse proxy, CDN, load balancer, shared hosting pool, or multiple workers. Conditional for simple local builds.
controls.required_test: Route traffic across multiple instances and test health checks.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Health endpoint, proxy config, multi-instance smoke test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Avoid local-only sessions where multiple servers exist. Session gate: session data must live in a shared or appropriate stateless mechanism.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the app is behind a reverse proxy, CDN, load balancer, shared hosting pool, or multiple workers. Conditional for simple local builds.
controls.required_test: Switch server during an authenticated flow and confirm session survives or fails safely.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Session config, cookie settings, shared session store proof.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use queues for slow work. Async work gate: slow email, import, export, report, image, payment follow-up, and integration work must not block user requests.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature triggers slow work, retries, background jobs, emails, reports, imports, exports, integrations, or multiple follow up actions.
controls.required_test: Trigger slow work and confirm immediate response plus background completion.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Queue job definition, job log, completion record.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Make consumers idempotent. Queue retry gate: every consumer must survive duplicate delivery.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature triggers slow work, retries, background jobs, emails, reports, imports, exports, integrations, or multiple follow up actions.
controls.required_test: Deliver same message twice and confirm one final effect.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Consumer test, deduplication rule, processed message log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add retries and acknowledgements. Reliable job gate: queue work must define acknowledgement, retry, timeout, and failure rules.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature triggers slow work, retries, background jobs, emails, reports, imports, exports, integrations, or multiple follow up actions.
controls.required_test: Force worker crash before acknowledgement and confirm retry behaviour.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Retry policy, failed job log, acknowledgement evidence.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use Pub/Sub for event fan out. Event fan out gate: one domain event triggering many independent actions must use a topic or event pattern.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature triggers slow work, retries, background jobs, emails, reports, imports, exports, integrations, or multiple follow up actions.
controls.required_test: Publish one event and confirm each subscriber acts independently.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Topic map, subscriber logs, event contract.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose SQL schema carefully. Schema gate: tables, fields, types, relationships, and constraints must be designed before code writes data.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Migration creates schema and rejects invalid records.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: ERD or schema document, migration file, constraint test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use primary keys. Identity gate: every persistent record must have a stable primary key or equivalent unique identity.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Create, read, update, delete, and join records by the key.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Schema proof, migration file, CRUD test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use foreign keys where needed. Referential integrity gate: related records must not become orphaned where the database can enforce integrity.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Try deleting or inserting invalid related records.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Foreign key migration, constraint violation test, cascade rule.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use constraints. Data validity gate: not null, unique, check, length, status, and ownership constraints must protect important invariants.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Attempt invalid insert or update and expect rejection.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Constraint list, database test, failed invalid write output.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use indexes. Query performance gate: lookup, filter, sort, join, ownership, tenant, and pagination fields must be indexed where growth requires it.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when the feature stores, changes, deletes, imports, exports, or relates persistent data.
controls.required_test: Run explain plan or query timing on seeded data.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Index list, explain output, before and after timing.
